name: GTA
description: GTA is a benchmark for General Tool Agents designed to evaluate large language models' tool-use capabilities in real-world scenarios. It features human-written queries, real deployed tools across multiple categories, and real multimodal inputs such as images and code snippets to closely simulate practical tasks.
reputation: A recent benchmark for tool-using agents that has attracted interest in agent evaluation research, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Includes real user queries, real deployed tools, and real multimodal inputs; evaluates actual task execution performance.
